name: get_time_entries
description: Read finalized time entries actually tracked in the NamehAmal Mac app for the half-open range [start, end). Use this to compare actual tracked time against planned time (e.g. Google Calendar). Read-only: it never starts, stops, edits, or deletes entries. In-progress timers and deleted entries are excluded.

start.description: Inclusive range start as an ISO-8601 datetime, e.g. 2026-09-29T00:00:00+04:00.

end.description: Exclusive range end as an ISO-8601 datetime. Must be after start.

limit.description: Maximum entries to return (chronological). When truncated is true, narrow the range and call again.
